name: settings
title: Settings
description: Profile and workspace settings with one draft and real save handler. Personal mode omits workspace data; optional profile fields share validation, persistence, error recovery and focus return. Existing members, billing, notifications and API sections remain available.
whenToUse: The settings area of a SaaS product: personal, workspace, team, billing and developer settings behind one section list.
One section inside your own page (navigation none + section): it sits flush on your page's background and edge, under your heading.
notFor: A single preference (a switch where the setting takes effect).

anatomy: section list (a column; a scrolling row under 760px)
section header (title, description, last-saved caption, action)
plan cards, period toggle and plan-change bar
explicit rail, tabs or no section navigation; optional heading with an aside (e.g. where saves are kept); in tabs mode heading, tab row, form and save bar share one 720px column
dirty section markers and field error links
sticky save bar as wide as the form
states: invalid field (save disabled, field says why)
save failed (bar keeps the message, Save becomes Try again)
plan or period chosen, waiting for Switch plan
sections hidden when their data is not passed
saved confirmation for 1.6 seconds; last-saved time
discard returns focus to current section heading
field-tagged save rejection marks and focuses the named field
edits during a pending save remain as unsaved changes
optional profile fields share the same save flow
keyboard: Tab through the section list, then the section
dialogs and confirmations trap focus; Esc closes; confirmations start on Cancel
Save success and Discard return focus to the current section heading
A field-tagged save error focuses the visible field; Go to field switches section and focuses it
spec.motion: The save bar rises on --motion-in; toasts follow the toast stack.

props.name: defaultValues / values / onValuesChange
props.description: Saved profile, workspace and notification values, controlled or not.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Persist the draft; a rejection keeps the bar with its message.

props.name: plans / plan / defaultPlan / period / defaultPeriod / onPlanChange
props.description: Adds Billing; a change waits for Switch plan.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Rail folds to tabs below 760px; use tabs when embedded in a host shell, none for host-routed sections.

props.name: heading
props.description: Defaults to Settings; null leaves the page title to the host.

props.name: profileFields
props.description: Extra profile Inputs keyed by SettingsValues.profile; optional empty strings are valid and changed keys use profile.<id>.

props.name: SettingsValues.workspace / slug
props.description: Omit both for a personal profile; Workspace and its validation are then absent.

props.name: onSave rejection
props.description: Known field keys render inline and receive focus; unknown fields remain general errors. Never changes the saved baseline on failure.

props.name: defaultDraft
props.description: Optional restored draft applied once; shares the same validation, changed keys and save flow.

spec.appearance: Native div root ref/style and typed existing parts; refs compose with focus and React cleanup. Appearance preserves drafts, pending operations and dialogs. Member/key acknowledgements update only their records over the latest caller list; stale role completions do not overwrite a later request. Closing the created-key dialog clears its one-time secret before the next opening. When a save bar is visible, contained toasts clear its measured top edge so the Save action stays reachable, including after type/width changes.

notes: Foundations exception (O1 §14.2): `#000` in a mask-image is the mask's opaque stop (the overflowing tab row fades at its end); it decides what shows, it is not paint, and no look or theme changes it.
